tools.name: ask_jev
tools.description: Ask Jev, a fast (~300 ms) and nearly free decision model, one question about repo files or text: yes/no (noul), multiple choice (choice), or a position on levels (score). Use it for a judgment ABOUT content without reading it into your context: is this file relevant, does this log show the failure, which of these is riskiest. Read the file yourself when you need to edit or quote it. Values under ~0.7 mean Jev is unsure.

tools.name: find_code
tools.description: Find code by describing what it does, even when the codebase names it differently ("where is the register flow" finds a signup handler). Jev reads the files, not you: it screens every source file, re-checks the best in full and returns the files that carry it out, with the line. "No match" is a real answer. Use it before grepping for a concept.
